outcome: complications (postoperative, surgical difficulties at newborn extraction, postpartum)
cohort: 72 pregnancies from 67 women with colorectal endometriosis
finding: Pregnant women with colorectal endometriosis, regardless of prior surgery, have a high risk of caesarean section and vaginal delivery is associated with fewer postpartum complications.
mod_finding: Caesarean section in women with colorectal endometriosis was associated with a high incidence of postoperative complications (39%), while vaginal delivery was associated with a lower incidence of postpartum complications (14%).
